Toward behavioral economics of retirement savings among gig workers

Specific Aims

Aim 1: Advance behavioral economics of retirement savings among gig workers via a policy-focused strategy [1].

Aim 2: Advance behavioral economics of retirement savings among gig workers via a policy-focused strategy [2].

Background

Findings will be disseminated through peer-reviewed publication and open data release [3]. This proposal addresses behavioral economics of retirement savings among gig workers, a problem with substantial significance. The approach integrates established policy methods with a novel analytical pipeline. Prior work has established a partial understanding, yet key gaps remain.

Approach

Our preliminary data suggest a tractable path toward measurable improvement. Prior work has established a partial understanding, yet key gaps remain. Rigorous, pre-registered analyses will guard against bias and support reproducibility. Findings will be disseminated through peer-reviewed publication and open data release.

Innovation

Rigorous, pre-registered analyses will guard against bias and support reproducibility.

Investigator Context

The PI's first independent award; strong mentorship is in place. The R2 host institution offers focused departmental resources and regional research partnerships, backed by a growing institutional research base.
